name: COLA uplift on derived renewal net via prehook seed (commit, no $0)
what_it_tests: A derived renewal line eligible for COLA gets COLACalculatedPrice stamped to both InputUnitPrice and NetUnitPrice, and the prehook seeds NetUnitPrice (guarded null/<=0) so the renewal commits the uplifted value rather than $0
proc_mechanism: COLA Uplift on Renewal + COLA Uplift Net on Renewal (COLACalculatedPrice__c -> InputUnitPrice AND NetUnitPrice); COLAUpliftPrehook buildNetUnitPriceUpdate seeding NetUnitPrice via updateContextAttributes
expected_behavior: Renewal net = Asset.Price x (1+COLA%) (solution-category-matched from COLA_Uplift_Rules__mdt); both unit and net reflect uplift; no $0 commit
test_setup: Derived/TermDefined renewal, COLA_Uplift_Percent set, SalesTransactionActionType='Renew', LastTransaction source, Solution_Category matched (e.g. Cybersecurity 7.85%)
